## Summary

I investigated ticket T-6005 by examining the clickstream-ingest deployment in the ingest namespace. The pod logs revealed the root cause: the Kafka broker is throttling the producer with delays of 2.7-3 seconds per batch, causing the producer queue to reach 96% capacity and consumer lag to grow continuously. Scaling from 4 to 8 replicas had no effect because the bottleneck is broker-side rate limiting, not application capacity. Since the Kafka cluster is operated by the data platform team, I escalated this ticket for them to investigate and adjust broker quotas or configuration.
